# SOP-P1-L2-04 Shift handover - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01, EQ-P1-L2-IH02, EQ-P1-L2-HT03

Purpose: Ensure safe, complete, and auditable shift handover for Ring Rolling operations on line P1-L2.

Related documents: MM-P1-L2-IH02, QS-PROC-02, SB-1035

1. Preconditions
   1.1 Confirm production schedule and outstanding work orders on EQ-P1-L2-RR01.  
   1.2 Verify that maintenance holds or lockouts are recorded per MM-P1-L2-IH02.  
   1.3 Verify that there are no active quality holds referenced in QS-PROC-02.

2. Incoming operator review
   2.1 Outgoing operator communicates current process status, including any deviations, alarms, or tool changes.  
   2.2 Confirm the austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 855 °C.  
   2.3 Confirm coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 46 L/min.

3. Physical inspection
   3.1 Walkdown of EQ-P1-L2-RR01 for visible damage, loose guards, or foreign material.  
   3.2 Confirm furnace and heater external panels are secure; report discrepancies per SB-1035.

4. Instrumentation and records
   4.1 Validate control setpoints match required process values and log any changes per QS-PROC-02.  
   4.2 Ensure run logs and non-conformance records are current and accessible.

5. Communication and escalation
   5.1 Document unresolved issues and required actions.  
   5.2 Escalate safety-critical issues immediately to supervision.

Personal protective equipment (PPE)
- Hard hat
- Safety glasses
- Hearing protection
- Heat-resistant gloves for furnace access
- Steel-toe footwear

Sign-off
- Outgoing operator: name / signature / time  
- Incoming operator: name / signature / time  
- Supervisor: name / signature / time

Retention: Handover records must be filed in accordance with QS-PROC-02.
